Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1104
Claimant:
Shirley Rhodes
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-01-04
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second car, with
the claimant reporting a knee injury and retaining counsel before the file was opened.
2024-01-10
Confirmed that the driver listed as the insured is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time
reported.
2024-01-18
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene, though no independent witness
statements or photographs of the collision have been located to date.
2024-02-20
Reviewed the vehicle damage estimate; the crush pattern and point of contact are consistent with the impact
described in the first notice.
2024-03-18
Claimant's account was taken by phone and repeated again in a second conversation with counsel present, with the
sequence of events matching in each telling.
2024-04-06
Medical records show a knee injury whose type and severity fit the force expected from a side impact of this kind, and
no prior treatment to that body area has turned up in the records requested.
2024-04-13
Noted a few old scratches on the vehicle that may predate this collision; the photos will be reviewed to separate them
from new damage.
2024-06-23
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury, and the treating provider's
notes have been requested to understand the reasons for the extended course.
2024-07-08
Checked policy history and found nothing indicating the damage occurred before coverage began; the effective dates
remain consistent with the loss.
2024-07-11
Counsel has been asked for the claimant's full treatment list and any additional documents supporting the injury
claim; the file remains open pending receipt.
2024-07-28
Reviewed the file summary with the supervisor, who agreed that the outstanding items are the provider notes, the full
scratch photo set, and independent confirmation of the collision if any becomes available.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
